mapper.sql: VAL_ID VAL_ID, PROD_ID PROD_ID, ASSET_ID ASSET_ID, P_ASSET_ID P_ASSET_ID, VALUE_DATE VALUE_DATE, MDATE MDATE, POS_AMT POS_AMT, TDY_COST_AMT TDY_COST_AMT, TDY_FLOAT_INGPL TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, TDY_INTINCEXP TDY_INTINCEXP, DELAY_PAY_AMT DELAY_PAY_AMT, REMARK REMARK, CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, ORG_CODE ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE DEPT_CODE, CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, STATUS STATUS, DATA_SOURCE DATA_SOURCE, MD5PRIMARYKEY MD5PRIMARYKEY, CCY CCY
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA_CHILD CII USING (
SELECT #{item.valId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} VAL_ID, #{item.prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} PROD_ID, #{item.assetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ASSET_ID, #{item.pAssetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} P_ASSET_ID, #{item.valueDate,jdbcType=DATE} VALUE_DATE, #{item.mdate,jdbcType=DATE} MDATE, #{item.posAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL} POS_AMT, #{item.tdyCostAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL} TDY_COST_AMT, #{item.tdyFloatIngpl,jdbcType=DECIMAL} TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, #{item.tdyIntincexp,jdbcType=DECIMAL} TDY_INTINCEXP, #{item.delayPayAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL} DELAY_PAY_AMT, #{item.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} REMARK, #{item.orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORG_CODE, #{item.deptCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} DEPT_CODE, #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} UPDATE_TIME, #{item.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} CREATE_TIME, #{item.createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT, #{item.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} STATUS, #{item.dataSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} DATA_SOURCE, #{item.md5primarykey,jdbcType=CHAR} MD5PRIMARYKEY, #{item.ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CCY FROM DUAL
) TEMP
ON(CII.PROD_ID = TEMP.PROD_ID AND CII.ASSET_ID = TEMP.ASSET_ID AND CII.VALUE_DATE = TEMP.VALUE_DATE )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CII.VAL_ID = TEMP.VAL_ID, CII.P_ASSET_ID=TEMP.P_ASSET_ID, CII.MDATE = TEMP.MDATE, CII.POS_AMT = TEMP.POS_AMT, CII.TDY_COST_AMT = TEMP.TDY_COST_AMT, CII.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL = TEMP.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, CII.TDY_INTINCEXP = TEMP.TDY_INTINCEXP, CII.DELAY_PAY_AMT = TEMP.DELAY_PAY_AMT, CII.REMARK = TEMP.REMARK, CII.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, CII.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, CII.ORG_CODE = TEMP.ORG_CODE, CII.DEPT_CODE = TEMP.DEPT_CODE, CII.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.STATUS = TEMP.STATUS, CII.DATA_SOURCE = TEMP.DATA_SOURCE, CII.MD5PRIMARYKEY = TEMP.MD5PRIMARYKEY, CII.CCY = TEMP.CCY
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (VAL_ID, PROD_ID, ASSET_ID, P_ASSET_ID,VALUE_DATE, MDATE, POS_AMT, TDY_COST_AMT, TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, TDY_INTINCEXP, DELAY_PAY_AMT, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_DEPT, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER, STATUS, DATA_SOURCE,MD5PrimaryKey,CCY) VALUES( TEMP.VAL_ID, TEMP.PROD_ID, TEMP.ASSET_ID, TEMP.P_ASSET_ID, TEMP.VALUE_DATE, TEMP.MDATE, TEMP.POS_AMT, TEMP.TDY_COST_AMT, TEMP.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, TEMP.TDY_INTINCEXP, TEMP.DELAY_PAY_AMT, TEMP.REMARK, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.ORG_CODE, TEMP.DEPT_CODE, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.STATUS, TEMP.DATA_SOURCE, TEMP.MD5PRIMARYKEY, TEMP.CCY)
mapper.select: select distinct CDATE cdate from PTL_SEC_VALUTION where nvl(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME) > #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} order by cdate

select * from ( select psv1.PROD_ID as PROD_ID, psv1.FINPROD_ID as ASSET_ID, psv1.ccy, psv1.VALUE_DATE as VALUE_DATE, nvl(fp1.MDATE,fp2.MDATE) as MDATE, sum(psv1.POS_AMT) as POS_AMT, sum(psv1.TDY_COST_AMT) as TDY_COST_AMT, sum(psv1.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL) as TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, sum(psv1.TDY_INTINCEXP) as TDY_INTINCEXP, sum(psv1.DELAY_PAY_AMT) as DELAY_PAY_AMT, -- psv.DELAY_PAY_AMT as DELAY_PAY_AMT, max(psv1.UPDATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME from ( select psv.PORTFOLIO_ID as PROD_ID, nvl(NVL(fpf.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID), fp2.FINPROD_ID) as FINPROD_ID, psv.ccy, psv.CDATE as VALUE_DATE, decode(fp.finprod_type2,'F01',100*psv.SHARE_AMT,psv.SHARE_AMT) as POS_AMT, psv.DSC_COST_AMT as TDY_COST_AMT, psv.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL as TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, psv.TDY_INTINCEXP as TDY_INTINCEXP, psv.DELAY_PAY_AMT as DELAY_PAY_AMT, nvl(psv.UPDATE_TIME,psv.CREATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME from PTL_SEC_VALUTION psv left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fpf on fpf.FINPROD_ID = fp.P_FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fp2 on fp2.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID and fp2.branch = 0 where to_char(CDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')= #{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and exists( select 1 from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fp3 where fp3.PORTFOLIO_ID = psv.PORTFOLIO_ID) ) psv1 left join FIN_PRODUCT fp1 on fp1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = psv1.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fp2 on fp2.FINPROD_ID = psv1.FINPROD_ID and fp2.branch = 0 group by psv1.PROD_ID,fp1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,psv1.VALUE_DATE,fp1.MDATE,fp2.MDATE,psv1.FINPROD_ID,psv1.ccy ) a where a.ASSET_ID is not null
mapper.delete: delete from CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA where to_char(UPDATE_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') = to_char(sysdate,'yyyy-MM-dd')
mapper.select:
select * from ( SELECT psv1.prod_id AS prod_id, /*产品代码*/ psv1.asset_id AS asset_id, /*资产代码*/ psv1.ccy AS ccy, /*币种*/ psv1.value_date AS value_date, /*日期*/ psv1.mdate AS mdate, /*资产到期日*/ SUM(nvl(psv1.pos_amt,0)) AS pos_amt, /*当日持仓*/ SUM(nvl(psv1.tdy_cost_amt,0)) AS tdy_cost_amt, /*当日成本*/ SUM(nvl(psv1.tdy_float_ingpl,0)) AS tdy_float_ingpl, /*当日公允价值变动*/ SUM(nvl(psv1.tdy_intincexp,0)) AS tdy_intincexp, /*当日累计应计利息余额*/ SUM(nvl(psv1.delay_pay_amt,0)) AS delay_pay_amt, /*待清算款*/ MAX(psv1.update_time) AS update_time FROM ( SELECT c.finprod_market_id asset_id, /*资产代码*/ a.portfolio_id prod_id, /*产品代码*/ a.ccy ccy, /*币种*/ a.cdate value_date, /*日期*/ c.mdate mdate, /*资产到期日*/ a.share_amt pos_amt, /*当日持仓*/ a.dsc_cost_amt tdy_cost_amt, /*当日成本*/ a.tdy_float_ingpl tdy_float_ingpl, /*当日公允价值变动*/ a.tdy_intincexp tdy_intincexp, /*当日累计应计利息余额*/ a.delay_pay_amt delay_pay_amt, /*待清算款*/ nvl(a.update_time,a.create_time) update_time FROM ptl_sec_valution a INNER JOIN fin_product b ON a.finprod_id = b.finprod_id LEFT JOIN fin_product c ON b.chl_finprod_id = c.finprod_id WHERE 1=1 AND b.chl_finprod_id IS NOT NULL AND TO_CHAR(nvl(a.update_time,a.create_time),'yyyy-MM-dd')= #{batchTime,jdbcType= VARCHAR} AND exists( select 1 from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fp3 where fp3.PORTFOLIO_ID = a.PORTFOLIO_ID) )psv1 GROUP BY psv1.asset_id, psv1.prod_id, psv1.ccy, psv1.value_date, psv1.mdate ) a where a.ASSET_ID is not null union all select * from ( select psv1.PROD_ID as PROD_ID, nvl(nvl(fpf.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,fp1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID),psv1.FINPROD_ID) as ASSET_ID, psv1.ccy, psv1.VALUE_DATE as VALUE_DATE, nvl(fp1.MDATE,fp2.MDATE) as MDATE, sum(nvl(psv1.POS_AMT,0)) as POS_AMT, sum(nvl(psv1.TDY_COST_AMT,0)) as TDY_COST_AMT, sum(nvl(psv1.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0)) as TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, sum(nvl(psv1.TDY_INTINCEXP,0)) as TDY_INTINCEXP, sum(nvl(psv1.DELAY_PAY_AMT,0)) as DELAY_PAY_AMT, max(psv1.UPDATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME from ( select psv.PORTFOLIO_ID as PROD_ID, nvl(nvl(fp.P_FINPROD_ID,fp.FINPROD_ID),fp2.FINPROD_ID) as FINPROD_ID, psv.ccy, psv.CDATE as VALUE_DATE, decode(fp.finprod_type2,'F01',100*psv.SHARE_AMT,psv.SHARE_AMT) as POS_AMT, psv.DSC_COST_AMT as TDY_COST_AMT, psv.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL as TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, psv.TDY_INTINCEXP as TDY_INTINCEXP, psv.DELAY_PAY_AMT as DELAY_PAY_AMT, nvl(psv.UPDATE_TIME,psv.CREATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME from PTL_SEC_VALUTION psv left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fp2 on fp2.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO info on info.sec_acct_id = psv.sec_acct_id where (psv.sec_acct_id='999999' or info.sec_acct_id is not null) and to_char(nvl(psv.UPDATE_TIME,psv.CREATE_TIME),'yyyy-MM-dd')= #{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and fp2.branch = 0 and exists( select 1 from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fp3 where fp3.PORTFOLIO_ID = psv.PORTFOLIO_ID) ) psv1 left join FIN_PRODUCT fp1 on fp1.FINPROD_ID = psv1.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fpf on fpf.FINPROD_ID = fp1.P_FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fp2 on fp2.FINPROD_ID = psv1.FINPROD_ID
where fp2.branch = 0 group by psv1.PROD_ID,psv1.VALUE_DATE,nvl(fp1.MDATE,fp2.MDATE),nvl(nvl(fpf.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,fp1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID),psv1.FINPROD_ID),psv1.ccy ) a where a.ASSET_ID is not null
